children: According to CNBC, spending at brands specializing in emergency products rose about 400% from a year earlier between Nov. 12 and Nov. 17, when at least half a dozen major technology outages occurred in the U.S. Ready America’s e-commerce sales increased roughly fivefold in recent days, and the company asked suppliers to increase production. Mizuho expects Costco’s non-fuel sales growth in November to top 10% for the first time since 2022, as shoppers stock up on emergency supplies. The Global X Cybersecurity ETF (BUG) gained about 2.5% over the past two weeks, while the Nasdaq Composite fell into negative territory for 2026 on Friday.

title: Tech Outages Drive Surge in Emergency-Prep Spending
